73a:2.hebrew: יין נסך אסור ואוסר בכל שהוא כשהוא מתערב ביינות אחרים. ומפרטים: יין נסך שנתערב ביין של היתר וכן מים שנתנסכו לעבודה זרה, שנתערבו במים של היתר — אוסרים בכל שהוא, אבל יין שנתערב במים ומים שנתערבו ביין — אוסרים בנותן טעם.
73a:2.english: MISHNA: Wine used for a libation is forbidden, and any amount of it renders other wine forbidden if they are mixed together. Wine used for a libation that became mixed with wine, or water that was used for an idolatrous libation that became mixed with ordinary water, renders the mixture forbidden with any amount of the forbidden wine or water; but wine used for a libation that became mixed with water, or water used for a libation that became mixed with wine renders the mixture forbidden only if the forbidden liquid is sufficient to impart flavor to the mixture, i.e., for the wine to flavor the water or for the water to dilute the wine to an extent that can be tasted.

73a:3.hebrew: זה הכלל: מין שנתערב במינו — אוסר במשהו, ושלא במינו — אוסר בנותן טעם.
73a:3.english: This is the principle: A substance in contact with the same type of substance renders the mixture forbidden with any amount of the forbidden substance, but a substance in contact with a different type of substance renders the mixture forbidden only in a case where it imparts flavor to it.
